doc: First-time tips on an expedition (scripts/match/match_tips.gd). Each tip is one line that shows once, the first time its moment comes up, and then lives in the Tips log (pause menu). What the Trial Expedition teaches isn't a tip. {boki} is your Boki's name; any other {action} is that key's cap (Settings.key_cap). reminders: the short card when you try something that can't work; remind_s: how long it stays up (s).

tips.skill: Stun a foe with {boki}'s ability, then hit it for a combo
tips.ult: Bond full: press {ultimate} to fuse with {boki}
tips.catch: Hold {interact} to scan this Boki. Rivals hear it; get out to keep it
tips.exit_dock: Call the skiff at the horn, hold out, then board before it leaves
tips.exit_hatch: A Rift Key opens this hatch ({interact}). Three can drop through
tips.down: You're down: a trusting Boki may pick you up
tips.rings: Glide through the glowing rings for a burst of speed
tips.stagger: A purple ring: hit that monster with an ability to stagger it
